reason: The pinned external roc-validator 0.11.2 installation exposes base profiles for RO-Crate 1.1 and 1.2 but no RO-Crate 1.3 profile. Running the package against the 1.2 profile would substitute the frozen target standard and create false validation evidence.

amendment.external_reader_result: Record the exact unsupported-profile result; do not present roc-validator as RO-Crate 1.3 validation.
amendment.release_gate: The dependency-free clean-room reader must check the mandatory RO-Crate 1.3 structure directly against the frozen official specification URI and prove exact native-object parity.
amendment.future_gate: An off-the-shelf validator counts only when it exposes an explicit RO-Crate 1.3 base profile. No downgrade or profile substitution is permitted.
